name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B
purpose: Generative Remove: fills areas too large for content-aware Remove, labelled as generated fill.
notes: Converted by research/prototypes/generative/convert_flux.py from black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-4B: the transformer's blocks quantised to 4 bits (2.22 GB, chosen by measurement in RM-10's step 2), the VAE as it is, and the prompts Generative Remove uses encoded, so no text encoder ships. Runs through MLX in RedlampGenerative. Its training data is undisclosed; the owner allowed it as an opt-in download labelled as generated fill (DEC-23). Published as the prerelease models-flux2-klein-4b-fill-v1 with its licence (LICENSE.txt), once the owner approved the upload (DEC-26, 2026-10-06). Tested on Macs with 16 GB of memory: a 1024-pixel fill peaks at 6.6 GB on an M1 Ultra. Macs with less are offered it with a note that it hasn't been tested on them (RM-15).
